title: hieracium rohacsense subsp. rauzense
intro: Hieracium rohacsense subsp. rauzense, commonly known as hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral actions. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium rohacsense subsp. rauzense include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
